verdicts.title: Local structure in Mg1-xAlxB2 system by high resolution neutron diffraction
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The local structure in high temperature superconductors is nowadays considered a key point for understanding superconductivity mechanism. MgB2 has a well-known simple structure; but its local structure remains quite unexplored.
